prompt:
You are one of two AI models competing to PRIORITISE a software engineer's inbox like he does. Last round he placed each item on two scales in a game:
- urgency 0-100: how soon he must look at it (100 = right now, 0 = can wait weeks)
- importance 0-100: how much it matters to him (100 = career/project critical, 0 = noise)
Your agreement with his placements (1 - distance, weighted by how sure he was on each scale): 61% over 28 items.
Items where you were furthest off (subject: yours -> HIS, as urgency/importance):
- "Question about project deadline": 50/30 -> 93/100
- "Your application was viewed": 0/20 -> 77/87
- "CI/PR/Issue: Resolved": 0/0 -> 3/96
- "Interview confirmed: Thu 13:00": 0/100 -> 97/100
- "Payment Due": 0/40 -> 97/21
- "[games] PR #14 review requested": 0/10 -> 70/72
- "Re: Frontend role, follow-up": 20/80 -> 87/85
- "New Job Posting: Senior Software Engineer": 50/90 -> 86/38
- "Invoice 1234 - Payment Due": 0/70 -> 84/46
- "Gemma, Qwen and Llama compared on CPU": 30/50 -> 73/75
His mean placement by sender type (urgency/importance): collaborator 72/71; github 37/84; invoice 90/36; job-board 69/56; marketing 29/43; newsletter 33/47; recruiter 83/83; service 78/49
Your summary badges won 1/2 of the A/B style questions he answered.
Tasks:
1. Write a revised prioritising rubric: 3 to 5 short rules that would match HIS priorities better.
2. Write 10 NEW fictional inbox items of the kinds he gets: recruiter replies, job-board digests, code-host (CI/PR/issue) notifications, service notices, marketing, collaborator questions, invoices, newsletters. Make some of them hard to prioritise (urgent but unimportant, important but not urgent).
Rules for items: sender is a role plus a made-up company, like "Recruiter · Pinewood Talent" or "Code host notifications"; NO personal names, NO email addresses, NO URLs, NO phone numbers, no placeholders like [name]. subject max 60 characters, snippet is one full sentence of 40 to 110 characters (the first line of the mail body). senderType one of: recruiter, job-board, github, service, marketing, collaborator, invoice, newsletter. Give your urgency and importance for each.
Example item (do not copy it): {"senderType":"recruiter","sender":"Recruiter · Pinewood Talent","subject":"Re: Backend role, quick follow-up","snippet":"Thanks for applying. Are you open to a 20 minute call on Thursday or Friday?","badge":"call request","urgency":80,"importance":75}
Return JSON only, exactly 10 parcels: {"rubric":["rule 1","rule 2","rule 3"],"parcels":[ ... ]}
